title: 8.1.9 Lab: Write It Yourself
description: Write a box and a hole in Code, from scratch, with no buttons. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Write the box
steps.instructions: In script.js, write a line that makes a box 30 mm wide, 30 mm deep, and 10 mm tall, and saves it to a variable called b.
hints: The pattern is const b = box(width, depth, height).
Put the three numbers in order: width, then depth, then height.

steps.title: Write the hole
steps.instructions: On the next line, drill a hole 5 mm across through b.
hints: Don't forget the curly braces around across: 5.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Press Run and check the 3D view: a small flat box with a hole through it.
hints: If the view stays empty, check for a red error in the console below the editor and fix the line it points to.

requirements.title: A 30 x 30 x 10 box with a 5 mm hole
requirements.description: A box 30 mm wide, 30 mm deep, and 10 mm tall, with a hole 5 mm across drilled through it.
requirements.hint: const b = box(30, 30, 10), then hole(b, { across: 5 }).
